mechanism_claims.claim_text: MCoAA-02 is supported as an anti-angiogenic phenotypic lead in VEGF-mediated HUVEC migration, with reported 50% inhibition at 1 nM under the paper assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports anti-migration phenotype, not direct receptor binding or direct signaling-target engagement.
